about: Curated curriculum links for the Skill Half-life Radar. 'pairs' are skills taught together (BridgeEdge kind co-occurs); prerequisite edges come from the Bridge Map. 'successors' are where demand for a cooling skill tends to move; one is only suggested when the live forecast says it is rising. 'keywords' pick the learning outcome a refresh note links to.

pairs.why: LLM apps are built on the transformer and sequence models this module explains
PyTorch is the framework students would use to build the networks this module derives
MLOps is how the models this module trains get versioned, shipped and monitored
Vector databases apply the indexing and query processing this module teaches to embeddings
Services like the ones this module designs are shipped as containers
Kubernetes runs replicated, fault-tolerant services like the ones this module designs
Cloud platforms are where the distributed services this module designs run
Evaluating an LLM app is part of building one
Retrieval for LLM apps runs on a vector store
Continuous integration runs the tests this module teaches on every push
